prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is large enemy scale (20-40 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a SIEGE unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Banner Maw, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Major.
Creature Category: Forgotten Hollow.
Combat Role: SIEGE.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW BANNER MAW — A low quadruped made of torn banners with a hidden mouth.

BODY: Low, wide quadruped — 15-20 feet long, 8-10 feet tall. NOT an animal — the body is made from TORN BANNERS draped over a framework of bone-pole ribs. The banners are charcoal-black and ash-grey, covered in erasing sigils — the heraldry of civilizations consumed by the Hollow. The sigils are actively fading, the cloth actively being erased. The banners hang and drag, forming a tent-like body. Beneath the banners: void-stuff framework, bone-pole ribs (NOT bone, but void-stuff shaped like ribs), and a dark interior that shows ACTIVE NOTHING when the banners shift.

MASK: No face — the front of the creature is just more draped banners. But beneath the banners, a MOUTH is hidden — a wide, flat maw of white fracture cracks arranged in a jagged smile pattern. The mouth is only visible when the banners part. No eyes. No nose. Just the hidden maw beneath cloth.

LEGS: Four legs made of void-stuff wrapped in more banner cloth. The legs are thin, pole-like — like the standards of a conquered army, bent and used as legs. Each "leg" is a broken banner pole with cloth wrapping.

GATE STONE: Broken Gate-arch fragments are embedded along the spine — a row of broken arch-stones running along the back, under the banners. The stones are dark grey, cracked, with cold white anti-light between them.

POSE: Low to the ground, prowling, banners dragging. One banner is raised slightly, showing erasing sigils. The mouth is partially visible — banners parting at the front to reveal the white fracture-crack maw. The pose should feel like a predator crawling through the ruins of a conquered civilization.

SCALE: 15-20 feet long, 8-10 feet tall. Camera at ground level, looking at the creature from the front-low angle. The Banner Maw should look like a crawling pile of dead flags — a nations's worth of consumed heraldry dragging itself forward.

GROUND: The ground around the Banner Maw is littered with fallen banners — shreds of cloth with fading sigils, scattered like dead leaves. Erased heraldry patterns on the ground — the ghost of crests and shields being scrubbed away. Ash falling upward. The earth looks like a battlefield that has been forgotten.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that looks like a conquered battlefield — broken banners on distant spikes, ruined standards, the silhouette of a fallen city in the void-fog. Palette: charcoal-black, ash-grey, tattered cloth-brown, cold white, faint banner-color ghosts (fading).

VFX: Erasing sigils on banners visibly fading. White fracture-crack maw glowing faintly when banners part. Banners drifting and dragging. Anti-light absorption. Ash falling upward.

SILHOUETTE: Low, wide, four-legged, draped in cloth. Reads as a siege/creature unit — the banner-draped quadruped silhouette is unique among Hollow creatures. The hidden maw beneath cloth is the primary threat indicator.
